ethical.en: We’ll look at the benefits, at the risks, and at the ethical questions surrounding surveillance.
ethical.zh: 我们将探讨监控带来的好处、风险以及围绕监控的伦理问题。

ethical.en: Modern ethical guidelines for psychological experiments would see it as far too harmful.
ethical.zh: 按照现代心理学实验的伦理准则，这场实验的危害性实在太大了。

ethical.en: In the immediate aftermath, it was criticised on an ethical level.
ethical.zh: 实验结束后不久，它就在伦理层面受到了批评。

ethical.en: For the Games' critics, doping crosses an ethical line.
ethical.zh: 对于运动会的批评者来说，使用兴奋剂越过了道德底线。

ethical.en: But the critics, of course, say that this crosses an ethical line, that it sets a dreadful example because it risks normalising doping.
ethical.zh: 但批评者当然表示，这越过了道德底线，树立了一个可怕的榜样，因为它有使兴奋剂常规化的风险。

eternal.en: The boy’s name was Hannibal. Now, to understand why a father might make his child swear eternal hatred towards another state, we need to look at the world Hannibal was born into.
eternal.zh: 这个男孩名叫Hannibal。现在，为了理解为什么一个父亲会要求自己的孩子发誓对另一个国家永世为敌，我们需要看看Hannibal出生的那个世界。

eternal.en: For starters, for thousands of years there was not even agreement on whether the deep sea ever “finished”, whether there was a floor to the ocean, or whether it was an eternal abyss of water.
eternal.zh: 首先，几千年来，人们甚至无法就深海是否“有尽头”、海洋是否有海底，或者它是否是一个永恒的水渊达成共识。

ethnic.en: Singapore officially recognizes four broad ethnic categories: Chinese, Malay, Indian, and other.
ethnic.zh: 新加坡官方承认四大广泛的族群类别：华人、马来人、印度人和其他。

ethnic.en: The government wanted different ethnic groups to live alongside each other rather than being separated into different communities.
ethnic.zh: 政府希望不同的族群能够生活在一起，而不是被隔离开来进入不同的社群。

ethnic.en: And thirdly, it was just too large and had too many competing different ethnic and religious groups—the Arabs, the Greeks, the Armenians, and the Slavs, to name but a few.
ethnic.zh: 第三，它实在太大了，有着太多相互竞争的不同民族和宗教群体——仅举几例，就有阿拉伯人、希腊人、亚美尼亚人和斯拉夫人都。

ethics.en: Researchers now have to ensure the safety and well-being of their participants, and they must get approval from ethics committees before starting any study.
ethics.zh: 如今，研究者必须确保参与者的安全和福祉，而且在开展任何研究之前，都必须获得伦理委员会的批准。

ethics.en: And then there’s the question of ethics.
ethics.zh: 接下来是伦理层面的问题。
